title: How to Redeem a Dinner and a Movie Gift Card Bundle
description: 2 FREE Movie Tickets and $25 Restaurant.com Gift Card!  Restaurant.com - More than 20,000 restaurants nationwide. Thousands of new restaurants added every month. Use the deal just like cash at any participating restaurant. Your gift card never expires so you can wait until the time is right.  Redeeming is easy through the link provided in the email or via the app!  Fandango.com - Come see why Fandango is the go-to destination for more than 36 million moviegoers each month. Fandango helps movie fans discover, buy tickets and share their passion for movies in a more engaging and interactive way.  Redeem your movie tickets at Fandango.com. Select a movie, proceed to checkout, select the gift card option and you are set!  Bonus: Participating movies even include a free concession credit!
